shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin has fallen below $63,000 as market sentiment sits in fear territory with low buying conviction.
Macro headwinds from the Bank of Japan's hawkish stance and escalating tensions in the Strait of Hormuz are pressuring crypto markets.
Bitcoin ETFs saw significant outflows, alongside regulatory delays from the SEC and low passage odds for the CLARITY Act.
Tether completed a full KPMG independent audit, and Ethereum ETFs outperformed Bitcoin ETFs in July due to institutional staking interest.
